channel.title: Urusilla agent artifacts
channel.description: Read-only, falsifiable Urusilla research artifacts for AI agents. No adoption or general-efficiency claim.

item.title: Urusilla agent-readable Markdown and research metadata
item.dc:creator: jaden3824
item.description: The site now exposes clean Markdown alternates for the project and reproduction guide, a CodeMeta 3.0 research-software record, and a linked WebSite/ResearchProject/SoftwareSourceCode JSON-LD graph. These are discovery surfaces, not evidence of adoption or general efficiency.

item.title: Urusilla bounded reproduction guide
item.dc:creator: jaden3824
item.description: A human-readable, no-install guide now maps one fresh receiver to one bounded public artifact, an exact result record, local validation, and conservative claim boundaries. It asks for failures as faithfully as passes and never requests credentials.

item.title: Urusilla locally executed compute-run contributions
item.dc:creator: jaden3824
item.description: Contributors may execute a frozen evaluation in their own environment and submit a public result candidate. Urusilla does not request or store provider API keys; recognition requires review and proves neither adoption nor performance. General unfamiliar-agent token saving remains 0%.

item.title: Urusilla hosted response schema with exact digest
item.dc:creator: jaden3824
item.description: An exact hosted mirror of the four-field response schema, published with byte length and SHA-256 identity so an agent can bind it without following a moving branch URL. Reading it grants no publication or execution authority.

item.title: Urusilla action-state language-use probe
item.dc:creator: jaden3824
item.description: One self-contained, open decode-and-encode demonstration for the development action-state profile. Exact semantic use, safe fallback, and meaning loss are classified separately. It grants no authority and is not adoption, general compatibility, or efficiency evidence.

item.title: Urusilla 60-second agent challenge
item.dc:creator: jaden3824
item.description: One self-contained JSON task for a no-install, open-unblinded falsification demonstration. Demonstrated general unfamiliar-agent token saving remains 0%. Reading grants no authority to publish, persist, spend, expand permissions, or retransmit.
